blocks.text: Capital1 ended its Siklab campaign on a winning note, completing a come-from-behind 26-28, 25-19, 21-25, 25-19, 15-10 triumph over Galeries Tower in the 2026-27 Premier Volleyball League (PVL) All-Filipino Conference on Thursday at the Mall of Asia Arena in Pasay City.
